text:
Priya: quick heads-up — planning a small autoscale policy tweak on gpu-pool-reserved-3 today at 14:00 PT. low-risk, canary on slice-7 (10% traffic). posting here for visibility and smoke/rollback readiness. rollout window 14:00-15:00 PT.

Jay: who is doing the deploy? I can own smoke checks.

Priya: I will trigger the rollout and watch infra metrics. @Jay please run the smoke checklist (short+long kernels) and confirm KV cache hit rates + 95p latency. @ops-bot will run canary gating after 10m.

Jay: ack. what are the exact steps?

Priya: steps —
1) trigger rollout to slice-7 canary
2) wait 10m, run smoke workload
3) if metrics good, stage to slices 8-10 every 10m
4) full cutover if no flags.

Policy patch (applies autoscale thresholds):
```json
{
  "policy_name": "reserved-3-autoscale-v2",
  "min_replicas": 2,
  "max_replicas": 10,
  "scale_up_threshold": 0.75,
  "scale_down_threshold": 0.25,
  "burst_buffer": 2
}
```

Erin: need rollback command and gating thresholds in writing before deploy.

Priya: Rollback command: `rctl rollout revert --pool reserved-3 --revision v20240714`
Gating thresholds (canary): GPU util sustained > 85% for 5m OR 95p latency > 400ms OR error rate > 1% -> immediate rollback. Also watch KV cache hit drop > 10pts.

Jay: smoke script: `./tools/smoke.sh reserved-3 --slice slice-7 --qps 50 --patience 600` — will run short chat (avg tokens 40) and long completions (avg tokens 800). reporting back in thread.

Chris: I'll be on infra standby for fast rollback and logs access. tagging Maya for alerting changes.

Maya: I'll create a temp dashboard for slice-7 and bump trace sampling. I will also silence non-critical alerts to avoid noise.

Priya: target deploy 14:00 PT. I'll post stage updates here. If no issues after 20m of canary we'll continue staged rollout to remaining slices every 10m.

Jay: 14:15 PT — canary results: ~200 requests run. 95p latency 180ms, error rate 0.1%, GPU util 62%, KV cache hit 87% :thumbsup:

Priya: great. proceeding to stage 2 -> slices 8-10. will start at 14:26 PT. @ops-bot kick off stage.

ops-bot: Deploy started: rollout_id r_6742 -> targeting slices [8,9,10]. Monitor with `rctl rollout status r_6742`.

Jay: monitoring metrics and traces. will flag here if anything odd.

Maya: alerts quiet. will escalate if error > 0.5% or sudden cache drop.

Priya: reminder: rollback = `rctl rollout revert --pool reserved-3 --revision v20240714` + `rctl blacklist-policy reserved-3-autoscale-v2` to stop further propagation.

Chris: one note — burst_buffer increases reserve by 2 GPUs during spikes; finance has been notified of potential short-term bump. @Finance Bot has the billing alert configured.

Finance Bot: billing watch enabled for pool reserved-3; threshold set to +$1k/day deviation.

Jay: 14:45 PT — stage 2 stable: 95p latency 200ms, error 0.12%, GPU util 68%. proceeding to full cutover at 14:55 PT unless objection.

Priya: no objections. full cutover at 14:55 PT. will close thread after final checks and post rollout_id + perf diff doc. thanks everyone.
